references.title: Constructive Separations and Their Consequences
references.role: Defines and studies efficient refuters as constructive complexity separations.

references.title: Convergent Gate Elimination and Constructive Circuit Lower Bounds
references.role: Provides convergent circuit simplification and a constructive gate-elimination lower bound.

references.title: Constructive Separations from Gate Elimination
references.role: Extends efficient counterexample extraction to several gate-elimination arguments.

references.title: Circuit Depth Reductions
references.role: Records the quantitative limitation of purely gate-elimination lower bounds and motivates non-gate-elimination routes.

references.title: Hardness Magnification near State-of-the-Art Lower Bounds
references.role: Supplies candidate magnification interfaces from weak lower bounds to strong circuit lower bounds.

references.title: Beyond Natural Proofs: Hardness Magnification and Locality
references.role: Identifies locality obstacles that a constructive refuter magnification theorem must avoid.

references.title: Resolution Width Lifts to Near-Quadratic-Depth Res(oplus) Size
references.role: Provides a current proof-complexity lifting component for certificate-rich hard CNF families.

references.title: Hard CNF Instances for Ideal Proof Systems
references.role: Provides hard CNFs for a restricted algebraic proof system and a candidate test family for proof-carrying refuter languages.
